features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1932: High-energy carbon fiber orthosis designed for foot drop and knee stability.
ENERGY-BOOSTING TECHNOLOGY: Stores energy on heel strike and releases it during push-off for efficient movement.
ERGONOMIC KNEE SUPPORT: Assists with both knee flexion and extension for smoother, safer motion.
LIGHTWEIGHT, SLIM CONSTRUCTION: Carbon composite frame fits under clothing and inside most footwear for discreet comfort.
HIGH-MOBILITY DESIGN: Ideal for users seeking dynamic gait correction and support during active movement.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
